hero.kicker: You've seen this mark stamped into a gold ring, a chain, a bangle.
hero.heading: Now you can ask what it actually means.
hero.subheading: SAATHI answers only from a verified Indian Standard — and tells you plainly when it can't.

examples.question: Is BIS certification mandatory for two-wheeler helmets?
examples.answer: Yes. Protective helmets for two-wheeler riders must conform to the BIS safety specification, and manufacturers are required to hold a valid BIS licence (ISI mark) before sale.

examples.question: Do household electrical appliances need BIS certification?
examples.answer: Yes, household electrical appliances must comply with the applicable BIS safety standard before they can be sold.

examples.question: Is the BIS Hallmark mandatory for gold jewellery retailers?
examples.answer: The BIS Hallmark on gold jewellery certifies purity and is mandatory for retailers under the Hallmarking Scheme.

examples.question: Does packaged drinking water sold in India need BIS certification?
examples.answer: Packaged drinking water sold in India must be certified under the mandatory BIS scheme before it can be marketed.

examples.question: Do pressure cookers sold in India need an ISI mark?
examples.answer: Pressure cookers manufactured or sold in India must carry the ISI mark under this specification.

trust.heading: Cited, or honest. Never guessed.
trust.body: Every SAATHI answer traces back to a real IS standard number and clause. When no verified standard applies, SAATHI says so — it doesn't improvise one.
trust.citedPoint: A verified standard resolves into a stamped plate: the exact IS number, its clause, and where it comes from.
trust.declinedPoint: No verified match resolves into an empty plate — honestly unstamped, never invented.

audience.heading: Built for buying, certifying, and auditing.

consumer.title: Checking before you buy
consumer.subtitle: Public citizens and everyday shoppers
consumer.body: Is this helmet actually ISI-marked because it has to be, or because the box just says so? Ask before you hand over the money.

chat.question: "Is this three-pin plug actually ISI-marked because it has to be?"
chat.answer: "Yes — IS 1293:2019 makes this mandatory under the Quality Control Order."

business.title: Certifying before you sell
business.subtitle: Manufacturers and compliance teams
business.body: Which IS standard applies, which clause governs it, and which licence you need — before an audit finds the gap.

chat.question: "Generate the factory test checklist for Ordinary Portland Cement, 43 grade."
chat.answer: "IS 269:2015 — minimum 43 MPa 28-day compressive strength, plus initial setting time."

auditor.title: Verifying before you sign off
auditor.subtitle: Technical officers and conformity assessors
auditor.body: Cross-check a lab report against the exact clause it's meant to satisfy, with the tolerance and citation attached — before it goes in the file.

chat.question: "Check this lab result: lead at 0.03 mg/L in a water sample."
chat.answer: "Non-compliant — IS 10500 Clause 4.2 caps lead at 0.01 mg/L, no exceptions."

about.heading: Built for SIH26107 — the BIS Navigator.
about.body: SAATHI is built for the Smart India Hackathon 2026 under problem statement SIH26107. It is designed to make Indian Standards accessible: ask a question, get a cited answer, or an honest decline when no standard applies.

ask.title: Ask in Plain Language
ask.subtitle: Ask about a product, a mark, or a certification scheme in the language you're comfortable in.

match.title: Match to a Verified IS Standard
match.subtitle: SAATHI looks up the relevant Indian Standard in its verified knowledge base before answering.

cite.title: Cited Answer or Honest Refusal
cite.subtitle: Get a pinpoint clause citation, or an explicit statement that no verified standard was found.

coreRule.quote: Every answer must trace back to a real IS standard number and clause, or it plainly says no verified standard was found — it never guesses. And because compliance questions don't come in one language, SAATHI answers in the language you asked in.
coreRule.context: Smart India Hackathon 2026 · Problem Statement SIH26107
